Figure with figcaption preserves both image and caption

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<figure><img src="sunset.jpg" alt="A sunset"><figcaption>Beautiful sunset over the ocean</figcaption></figure>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
